item.title: Version 1.2.2
item.description: - Imporoved Real-Time Clipboard Latency - Enhanced Restoration - Hold Shift during selection to select range of items at once, Ctrl/Cmd + A for selecting all visible on screen. - Improved download indicator for large files. - Automatically fixes inconsistent time issue across platform. - Change Root Directory: Now change copycat database root directory by setting COPYCAT_DB_ROOT under the os environment settings. - Bug Fixes: Resolved various issues for a smoother experience.
